run_train_model: run the fairseq training script to train a new model on one or multiple GPUs
run_distributed_training: run distributed training across multiple GPUs using torch multiprocessing spawn
run_single_epoch_train: run the train function to train the model for one epoch with batched samples
run_validate_model: run validation on specified subsets and return validation losses for checkpointing
run_cli_main: run the CLI entry point to parse args and start single or distributed training
